about: A candidate playbook for ab-run (deck@variant) and runner/ab.py --data. Only the playbook object is read; the deck's data stays in its own file.

playbook.notes: Science! (Dr. Madison Li: energy from artifact spells). From the draft (rocks, the commander, engines, creatures dearest first) plus the tap abilities stock Forge leaves idle: in twelve stock goldfish games Steel Overseer was in play for 19 turns, Arcade Gannon for 28 and Brotherhood Scribe for 13, and none was used once. They are used every first main phase (counters and the Scribe's team pump before combat, Gannon's loot), and Madison Li draws a card whenever she has three energy. Go-wide attack from two attackers up, the highest life first. Version 2 spends the energy: the pay-energy triggers of Assaultron Dominator, Sentry Bot, Robobrain War Mind, T-45 Power Armor and The Motherlode are taken whenever Forge asks; its AI declined them 233 times in version 1's forty goldfish games (the Dominator's alone 112 times). Goldfish, 40 seeds (1001-1040): stock 12.38 turns, the mechanical draft 12.60, version 1 12.03 (+0.35, 95% -0.13 to +0.83); version 2's 390 accepted triggers changed no kill turn (the energy is gone to Madison Li's draw by the time they ask). At the tables (ab-run #14, 200 tables, seed 20261145): 15 wins against stock's 14. Nothing; not shipped.
